scientific_question: Does the frozen P_T/a_T functional organization found in eight-item Liu tasks transport to smaller and larger relational problem sizes, or is it specific to the eight-item meta-training cardinality?
current_theory: The frozen model uses item-agnostic cue inputs and has transported its global/local division across topology, presentation order, and seven-to-nine observed-relation density. However, all backbones were meta-trained only on eight-item episodes, so cardinality transport remains an out-of-distribution algorithmic test.
primary_hypothesis: On prospectively selected N=6,8,10 degree-two connected support cycles with four presentations per relation, the frozen backbones and local gains will remain competent and retain constructive individualized global structure, P_T-dependent remote/nonlearned assembly, a_T-dependent direct fidelity, P-off/local nontransitivity, and exact local edge-ledger compression.
claim_boundary: A pass supports development transport of the frozen algorithm across the registered six-to-ten-item cycle family and three backbones. N=6 and N=10 are outside the backbone's N=8 meta-training distribution. Item count intentionally co-varies with support-relation count N, support trials 4N, query count N(N-1)/2, and direct-query fraction 2/(N-1), while holding mean support degree at two. The result does not establish arbitrary size scaling, retrained size-general learning, network-population prevalence, or a human/biological mechanism.

training_boundary.architecture_compatibility: The network input contains two fixed-width cue vectors plus task channels and has no item-index-sized parameter. P_T is hidden_size by hidden_size and a_T is cue_size squared. Variable N changes only the number of distinct cue codes and support/query trials.
training_boundary.evaluator_extension: Implement a separately source-locked variable-item evaluator that changes only the existing FrozenFastWeightEvaluator constructor's hard-coded N=8 guard. Every other method and task interface is inherited unchanged. It must exactly replay the frozen N=8 source cell before N=6 or N=10 is interpretable.
training_boundary.interpretation: N=6/10 competence is a prerequisite. Failure is cardinality competence not established, not evidence against a mechanism in a task the model did not solve.

size_matched_graph_contract.support_relations_rule: E=N, yielding one connected degree-two Hamiltonian cycle and mean support degree two at every size.
size_matched_graph_contract.target_distribution: The source-correct N=8 rank-distance multiset [1,2,3,3,3,4,5,7], normalized by N-1.
size_matched_graph_contract.selection_rule: For N=6 and N=10, enumerate all undirected Hamiltonian cycles on rank positions 0..N-1 in canonical form: start at rank 0 and require the second vertex to be smaller than the last. For each cycle, sort its undirected edge tuple and compute the exact one-dimensional Wasserstein-1 distance between its empirical normalized rank-distance distribution and the frozen N=8 target. Select the lexicographically first sorted edge tuple among all exact minimizers. N=8 is forced to the source-correct Liu graph and has distance zero. No neural, behavioral, checkpoint, local-gain, or human output enters selection.
size_matched_graph_contract.integrity: Verify exact cycle enumeration and tie counts, connectivity, degree two, E=N, graph descriptors, item labels/order, normalized signed evidence, four occurrences per relation, support/query counts, and deterministic schedule hashes before interpreting a cell.

task_contract.support: Passive observation, four blocks, every registered relation once per block, randomized order and left-right orientation, signed rank gap divided by N-1, no choice, no feedback.
task_contract.query: All unordered pairs in ten randomized blocks, both item cues visible, no distance input, no feedback, query hidden/eligibility reset, fast weights frozen.
task_contract.time: Normalize support trial index over that size's full support phase to the unchanged support/query boundary 2/3; query time remains 2/3.
task_contract.subject_encoding: Use the unchanged stable-omission state distribution and v2.4 differential evidence-admission equation at every size. Size-specific item-salience vectors and stable omissions are independently generated from the same registered seed; do not claim participant pairing across sizes.
task_contract.cue_codes: Use the unchanged deterministic permuted-shared cue generator with cue_size 15 and the registered cue seed independently at each N.
task_contract.fixed_model: Checkpoint, local gain, P_T update, a_T address/write/read, tanh, W_out, temperature, and all model parameters remain frozen.

evaluation.bootstrap_seed_rule: For N=8 reuse 760000 + 100 * backbone_seed + 1. For N=6/10 use 980000 + 100 * backbone_seed + size_index, with size_index one and three in registered order.
evaluation.bootstrap_unit: virtual participant within one item count and backbone
evaluation.execution: One bounded GPU process through a prospectively source-locked wrapper; size order N=6,N=8,N=10 and seed order 2101,2102,2103 are fixed.
evaluation.no_pooling: Never pool participants across sizes or networks and never use one size to filter another.

primary_links.intact_competence: Within every cell, participant-bootstrap lower bounds for intact learned and nonlearned exact decision accuracy both exceed 0.50.
primary_links.constructive_global_structure: Within every cell, intact and a-off Hodge-fraction lower bounds are at least 0.95, intact transitive-triplet lower bound is at least 0.95, and intact Hodge-order tau-to-true lower bound exceeds zero.
primary_links.size_normalized_individualized_stable_st: Within every cell, at least two eligible non-correct subjects exist, the mean inter-subject order-tau upper bound is below 0.80, and the bootstrap lower bound for mean 80-percent-stable-error pair density among eligible non-correct subjects is above zero. Report but do not gate the size-dependent probability of at least one stable error.
primary_links.P_off_global_collapse: Within every cell, P-off/a-on nonlearned correct-probability upper bound is at most 0.55 and P-off local remote minus 0.25 times intact global remote upper bound is below zero.
primary_links.P_remote_reassembly: Within every cell, global a-off disjoint relation-LOO and third-party relational lower bounds both exceed zero.
primary_links.a_off_direct_loss: Within every cell, intact minus a-off learned correct-probability lower bound exceeds zero.
primary_links.P_off_a_on_direct_nontransitive: Within every cell, P-off/a-on learned correct-probability lower bound exceeds 0.50 and learned-minus-nonlearned lower bound exceeds zero.
primary_links.exact_local_compression: Every finite-value and shape gate passes, and common-float64 tensor-state and all-query raw-read reconstruction maximum absolute errors are each at most 1e-12.

N8_replay_anchor: For every backbone, the variable-item evaluator's N=8 support schedules, cue codes, subject states/gains, neural fields, LOO fields, sampled behavior, and every shared metric/interval must exactly equal the frozen Liu-cycle E=8 source cell. Only the newly appended size-normalized stable-error-density metric and source/integrity metadata may differ.

outcome_tree.cell: A size-backbone cell passes only if all eight links and all source, artifact, graph-enumeration, size-interface, GPU-runtime, tensor-freeze, orientation, finite-value, exactness, and N=8 replay gates pass.
outcome_tree.size: An item count transports only if all three mandatory backbones pass independently.
outcome_tree.LIU_ITEM_COUNT_MECHANISM_TRANSPORTED: N=6,8,10 all transport. Promote the frozen asymmetric organization as development-supported across the registered item-count range while retaining the OOD and co-variation boundaries.
outcome_tree.ITEM_COUNT_DEPENDENT_OR_UNRESOLVED: At least one but not all item counts transports, or a primary link is heterogeneous across competent backbones. Localize only registered size and link effects; do not add sizes or retrain post hoc.
outcome_tree.FUNCTIONAL_ASYMMETRY_NOT_ITEM_COUNT_TRAN: All cells are competent and interpretable, N=8 replays, but neither N=6 nor N=10 transports the complete division. Retain eight-item Liu mechanism and reject cardinality transport.
outcome_tree.ITEM_COUNT_COMPETENCE_NOT_ESTABLISHED: Any N=6/10 cell fails intact learned or nonlearned competence. Its mechanism result is non-interpretable; report the OOD boundary without tuning or retraining within this contract.
outcome_tree.NONINTERPRETABLE_EXECUTION: Any source, artifact, enumeration, variable-item interface, N=8 replay, GPU-runtime, tensor-freeze, shape, orientation, finite-value, or exact-reassembly gate fails. Repair execution under a separately recorded lock without changing the science.

mandatory_secondary_reporting: all primary estimands and confidence intervals in all nine cells
learned, nonlearned, and overall sampled accuracy
symbolic-distance slope, normalized-distance slope, and size-generic serial endpoint contrast
ranking classes, historical at-least-one stable-error prevalence, stable-error pair density, and inter-subject order diversity
per-relation direct, disjoint, and third-party LOO effects
retained versus stable-omitted evidence counts and probabilities
all-query causal dependence on P_T and a_T
graph enumeration, normalized distance distribution, schedule hash, support/query count, and direct-query fraction
stop_rules: Do not change item counts, cycles, graph-selection metric, exposure rule, evaluator behavior beyond the N guard, seeds, participants, bootstrap, temperature, gains, thresholds, or estimands after implementation or evaluation.
Do not retrain on N=6/10, adapt the local gain, alter cue size, tune T/W_out/P_T/a_T, rescale evidence beyond rank_gap/(N-1), or choose size-specific parameters inside this contract.
Do not reuse the combinatorially size-dependent at-least-one-stable-error prevalence as a primary gate or change the registered size-normalized replacement after seeing results.
Do not begin list linking, classic transitive inference, Miconi ancestry, MEG, human-mechanism, or new global-compression work before this result is frozen and reported.
